description: This requirement is for new TVs ranging in size from 50-120 in, wall mounts to support the TVs, installation of the new TVs or monitors procured from other sources, removal of existing TVs or monitors of various sizes, transport of existing TVs and monitors to the warehouse, High-Definition Multimedia Interface (HDMI) cables in 20-50 ft lengths and connect new or existing wall mounted monitors to computers at Anniston Army Depot (ANAD).
